guide_hero_subtitle: This is a live demo of a production-ready full-stack template. Explore the features below — everything you see is built-in and ready to extend.
guide_tour_description: Walk through every feature step by step with a guided tour. It only takes a minute and covers everything NETrock has to offer.
guide_features_description: Each card highlights a key area of the template — click through to try them out.
guide_disclaimer_description: NETrock is not a CRM product — it's an open-source template that ships with a sample CRM pipeline to demonstrate real-world patterns. Everything you see here is meant to be customized and extended for your own project.
guide_step1_description: You've created your account. NETrock is a production full-stack template — .NET API + SvelteKit frontend with authentication, admin panel, and more features built in.
guide_step2_description: You're already using it! JWT tokens with refresh rotation, email verification, password reset, remember-me cookies — all built-in and production-ready.
guide_step3_description: Customize your profile with your name, avatar, phone number, and bio.
guide_step4_description: Build your sales pipeline — add contacts, track deal values, and manage leads.
guide_step5_description: View pipeline visualizations — deal values by status, source distribution, and recent activity.
guide_step6_description: User management, role assignment, account locking. The complete administrator experience.

meta_howItWorks_description: Discover the NETrock template architecture and tech stack.
howItWorks_hero_subtitle: A production-ready .NET 10 + SvelteKit template that ships with authentication, admin panel, background jobs, and more — so you can skip months of infrastructure work and start building features from day one.
howItWorks_architecture_description: Requests flow from the SvelteKit frontend through an API proxy to the .NET backend, which follows Clean Architecture with strict layer separation.
howItWorks_techStack_description: Modern, battle-tested technologies chosen for developer experience and production reliability.
howItWorks_quality_description: Every line of code passes through multiple quality gates — from AI-assisted development to automated testing and enforced conventions.
howItWorks_quality_ai_description: Claude Code follows project conventions defined in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. The AI understands the architecture and writes code that matches existing patterns — including tests.
howItWorks_quality_testing_description: Unit tests for pure logic, component tests for business rules, API integration tests for the HTTP pipeline, and architecture tests to enforce layer dependencies.
howItWorks_quality_conventions_descripti: Result pattern for error handling, TimeProvider for testable time, FluentValidation, ProblemDetails (RFC 9457), and strict TypeScript — no 'any' allowed.
howItWorks_quality_security_description: Permission-based authorization, CSRF protection, rate limiting, CSP with nonces, HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, and HttpOnly cookies.
howItWorks_features_description: Everything you need to launch a production application — already wired up, tested, and ready to extend.
howItWorks_features_authDesc: Token rotation, refresh, email verification, password reset, remember-me
howItWorks_features_permissionsDesc: Granular permissions, role hierarchy, full admin user management
howItWorks_features_emailDesc: Liquid templates, Resend integration, verification and reset flows
howItWorks_features_jobsDesc: Hangfire with PostgreSQL storage, recurring and one-time, admin UI
howItWorks_features_filesDesc: S3-compatible via MinIO, avatar processing with SkiaSharp
howItWorks_features_auditDesc: Append-only event log, per-user history, admin audit views
howItWorks_features_cacheDesc: Redis with circuit breaker, in-memory fallback, auto-invalidation
howItWorks_features_apiDocsDesc: OpenAPI auto-generated, Scalar interactive UI, versioned endpoints
howItWorks_features_i18nDesc: Compile-time i18n with Paraglide, type-safe, EN + CS included
howItWorks_features_healthDesc: PostgreSQL, Redis probes for container orchestration readiness
howItWorks_features_rateLimitDesc: Per-endpoint sliding window policies with friendly error responses
howItWorks_features_dockerDesc: Docker Compose with dev/prod overlays, Seq, MinIO console
welcome_splash_subtitle: A production-ready full-stack template — built to get you from zero to launch.
welcome_pillar_auth_desc: JWT tokens, refresh rotation, email verification, password reset
welcome_pillar_admin_desc: User management, roles with granular permissions, audit trail
welcome_pillar_jobs_desc: Scheduled tasks, execution history, pause and trigger on demand
welcome_pillar_infra_desc: Docker, health checks, i18n, structured logging, file storage
